notes: Script source of truth. Per scene and language: lines with text (captions), tts (what is spoken: respellings, sparse audio tags), anchors (name -> EN: first word containing it; ZH: substring), optional pauseAfterMs. Line ids mean the same thing in every language. Per scene: chapter (video chapter), musicSection (groups scenes into music sections; defaults to chapter), musicStyles. The voice-over pipeline turns this into public/data/vo.<cut>.json.

_voices_doc.elevenlabs: voice (voice id), voiceName, model, stability, seeds (takes per scene; best one auto-picked), tempo (atempo), maxPause (s), pauseScale, f0Max, keyTerms (names/terms a take must not lose; spellings joined by |)
_voices_doc.edge: voice (an edge-tts voice name), rate (e.g. '+0%'), pitch (e.g. '+0Hz'); free, no key
_voices_doc.recorded: the user's narration in recordings/<cut>/<scene id>.(wav|mp3|m4a|flac); whisperModel (default 'small'), tighten (default false); word timings come from ASR
_voices_doc.none: no audio; timings are estimated from cps (latin chars/s, default 15) / cpsCjk (CJK chars/s, default 5) so picture and captions can be built first
_voices_doc.lang: any cut may set lang to read another cut's text blocks with its own voice (e.g. a draft or variant cut)

negative: busy melody that competes with narration

lines.text: Grandfather clocks tick at a steady beat. Why that beat, and not faster?

lines.tts: 老式摆钟总是按固定的节拍走……为什么是这个节拍，而不是更快？

lines.text: A pendulum's swing time depends on just one thing: its length.

lines.text: The period is two pi times the square root of L over g.
lines.tts: The period is two pi, times the square root of L over g.

lines.text: Make it four times longer, and each swing takes twice as long.
